name: Translator API
plain: Translates text on the device between languages.
meaning: Page text stays local. Model downloads per language pair.

access.prompt_ui: Download per language pair on first use
access.iframe: Same as top level; cross-origin iframes need a permissions policy where listed

chrome.note: Availability may be subject to geographical restrictions.

data.metric: Translates text on the device between languages.

limits.headline: Can translate text on your device between languages, without sending it away
limits.user_action: You tap a button like Translate this page
can: Translate page text or what you typed between two languages
Download a model for each language pair the first time
Keep the text on your device
cannot: Start before a click or tap
Translate to a language pair whose model you did not download
Work in Firefox, Safari or on phones
Send your text to a server for this feature
limits.reach_label: One language pair at a time
limits.differs: Chrome and Edge on computers only.

story.what_it_is: A page can translate text between languages using an AI model on your device.

marketing.name: Translator API
marketing.pitch: Lets sites translate text locally with Chrome's built in AI, so it works offline and keeps text private.

story.for_you: You click Translate and the text changes to your language. It works after a language pack downloads. Your words do not go to an outside service.
story.for_makers: Makers add translation with no per message fee and without sharing user text. It opens markets and helps chat across languages. Quality may be lower than big cloud tools.

use_cases.example: A browser multiplayer game translates in game chat live, so players from different countries can talk.
A web chat translates a friend's message from Portuguese to English on tap.
A travel site translates reviews and signs in the page for a trip planner.
A video site translates captions on device as you watch.
A cross border store shows product details in your language.
A learning site translates a lesson for a student who is learning the school language.
A social site translates a post under its text with one tap.
A customer support site translates a chat between agent and customer.
